Subject: Pilot incentive proposal — request for bundled credits + pricing concession

Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the throughput and the latency profile. We discussed an 8-week pilot across two development teams (NLP and Search). Procurement asked whether Redwood can provide:

- $40k in usage credits applied to pilot usage (to offset token costs while we ramp)
- 25% off list pricing for a 3-month extension if pilot KPIs are met (we expect to go to paid in Q1)

Procurement noted they need this in writing to move the P.O. forward and asked for any standard paperwork or approval notes that show this as an exceptional commercial concession. Attached is our proposed SOW with pilot scope.

Can you confirm whether that mix of credits + discount is something Redwood can approve at the commercial level, or whether this needs an exec sign-off? Time is tight — they want to finalize the P.O. by Nov 5.

Best,
Amira Hassan
Head of Integrations
SysGen Therapeutics

Rafael / Monica,

I ran numbers with finance: our standard pilot credit cap for accounts at this stage is $15k without exec approval. The $40k request exceeds it by $25k. For discounts, our standard playbook allows up to 15% for add-on pilot extensions; 25% would require a written exec exception.

Here's a short impact summary I prepared for the approval note (to be sent to Marissa / CRO):
- Incremental revenue probability: high (product teams intend to go to paid after pilot per Amira)
- Expected 12-mo ARR if successful: ~$450k
- Cost (credits + margin impact from discount): estimated $52k NRR impact in year 1
- Strategic value: high — SysGen is a prospective strategic customer in oncology informatics and will be a referenceable integration partner

I can draft a one-paragraph ask for Marissa with numbers and suggested legal language for a short amendment (credits applied to pilot billing, discount applied to first 3 invoices post-pilot).

Attachments: pilot-incentive-summary.xlsx

— Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:11:03 -0700
Subject: Exec approval requested — SysGen pilot incentive bundle (credits + 25% extension)

Marissa — quick ask for your approval. Below is a 2-line summary and the suggested approval language we propose you sign off on. Priyom attached a short financial note.

Summary:
- Request: $40k usage credits for an 8-week pilot + 25% off list pricing for a 3-month paid extension if pilot KPIs are met
- Rationale: High conversion likelihood, referenceable customer in regulated life sciences, potential $450k ARR first year
- Timing: Procurement needs confirmation by 11/05 to issue P.O.

Suggested approval wording (for sign-off):
"Redwood Inference approves a one-time promotional pilot package for SysGen Therapeutics consisting of $40,000 in usage credits to be applied to pilot invoices and a one-time 25% discount applied to the first three monthly invoices following pilot completion, contingent upon mutual acceptance of pilot KPIs as defined in the attached SOW. This exception is limited to the SysGen pilot referenced in Deal RW-2026-1379 and will be documented via a short amendment to the Master Services Agreement."

Please reply with Approve / Decline and any edits. If approved, we'll route to Legal & Finance for amendment + DocuSign.

Thanks — Rafael
